propositions: dispatch_one.py exceeds the 800 LOC soft cap (~886 LOC) and must graduate off the module-size allowlist and ceilings.
The non-retrying update_one apply phases are extracted into a new leaf module dispatch_apply_phases.py that imports nothing from dispatch_one.
Retrying phases that call _call_with_retry stay in dispatch_one, keeping the new module a strict leaf.
The architecture.md remedy row named _update_one_apply_parent, but it uses _call_with_retry and cannot move cleanly, so a non-retrying-phase seam is taken and the remedy row is deleted.
Moved phase functions are re-exported from dispatch_one so bare-name and attribute-access calls keep resolving (back-compat).
The test monkeypatch for _record_reporter_alert is repointed to the leaf module while direct re-exported calls continue to work.
